meta.scope: Founder request: full character range of motion/aim on every input device (controller layouts, mouse, touch, keyboard). Scoped audit — not a whole-project sweep.
meta.baseline: b194fa9 on main and canonical production (/_health b194fa92d945, later 2531b3c records); 293/293 files and 1,961/1,961 tests, strict lint, deployable build green

gameLoopReview.loopTightness: Twin-stick aim is the core verb; a half-plane cap on controllers broke the loop for those players. Restored in b194fa9.
gameLoopReview.sessionEngagement: Controller players can now play every mode; menu navigation on non-zero pad slots is the remaining controller dead end.
gameLoopReview.soulFidelity: Proof over posture: each device's range is pinned by sweep tests, and the physical-pad gap is stated rather than implied.
nextMoves: Hands-on physical pad check across Chrome/Firefox/Safari (hardware-gated).

items.title: Full 360° controller aim on every gamepad layout
executionLog: b194fa9: resolveAimAxes (standard → 2/3, PlayStation non-standard → 2/5, resting-trigger detection, Xbox non-standard → 3/4); hasInput baseline; 30° assist cone; stale mouse.moved retired on stick aim and touchstart. Staging session-185-staging 7/7, production 7/7, exact-main workflow 39136409352 success.
items.why: Right-stick aim read fixed axes 2/3. Non-standard mappings put a trigger resting at -1 there, pinning Y and capping aim at 180°.
items.recipe: Select right-stick axes from the pad mapping and resting baseline; add 360° sweep tests for each layout and for controller/touch/mouse arbitration.

premises.claim: Right-stick axes are resolved per pad, not hard-coded
Aim assist is limited to a cone

L2.recipe: Mapping-aware resolver with trigger-rest detection, assist cone, stale pointer fix, sweep tests.

L3.recipe: Add an in-Settings live stick calibration readout and manual axis remap.

items.title: Settings and on-screen keyboard follow the active controller, not slot 0
executionLog: SettingsPanel and VirtualKeyboard now poll getPrimaryGamepad(); slot-1 selection and menu source-contract tests added in gamepad.test.js.
items.why: SettingsPanel and VirtualKeyboard poll navigator.getGamepads()[0]. A pad that connects in slot 1+ (common after a reconnect in Chrome, or alongside a virtual device) cannot navigate those screens even though gameplay — which uses getPrimaryGamepad — works.
items.recipe: Replace both getGamepads()[0] reads with getPrimaryGamepad(); add a test that a pad in slot 1 drives each screen.

L1.recipe: Swap to getPrimaryGamepad() in both components.

L2.recipe: L1 plus slot-1 regression tests for both screens.

L3.recipe: Extract one shared menu-gamepad hook for every polling screen.
